It drops -or to give the verb.

definition_zh: 引出；诱出；引起（反应）
definition_en: to draw out a response, fact or feeling that was not offered freely
core_image: 一根细线从水面下慢慢提起，把藏在深处的东西一点点带出水面
scene: 记者把录音笔推到桌子中间，只问了一个很轻的问题。The question elicited a long silence, then a name.
sceneCN: 这里 elicit 指引出回答或信息（第 1 个义项：把未主动说出的东西带出来）；句意为这个问题先引出沉默，然后引出一个名字。

pos.zh: 引出；诱出；引起

senses.title: Draw out an answer
senses.definition: to get someone to say something they had not planned to say
senses.definitionCN: 使某人说出原本没打算说的话
senses.example: The question elicited a long silence, then a name.
senses.exampleCN: 这个问题先引出沉默，然后引出一个名字。
senses.why: The word assumes resistance: the answer exists but is not on the surface, so it must be drawn.
senses.whyCN: 这个词预设了阻力：答案存在，却不在表面，因此必须被拉出来。

senses.title: Obtain a reaction
senses.definition: to produce a response from a body, a market or a crowd
senses.definitionCN: 使身体、市场或人群产生反应
senses.example: The new rule elicited protests from every department.
senses.exampleCN: 新规定引起每个部门的抗议。
senses.why: Reactions are also hidden until something touches them, and the touch is what elicits.
senses.whyCN: 反应也一直藏着，直到有东西触碰；而触碰就是 elicit。

senses.title: Extract a confession
senses.definition: to draw out an admission through questioning rather than force
senses.definitionCN: 通过提问而非强力取得承认
senses.example: The lawyer elicited a detail the witness had forgotten.
senses.exampleCN: 律师引出了证人已经忘记的一个细节。
senses.why: Careful questioning works like fishing: it does not push, it waits and lifts.
senses.whyCN: 细致的问话像钓鱼：不推，只等，然后提起来。

senses.title: Evoke a memory
senses.definition: to bring a half-lost memory back into speech or mind
senses.definitionCN: 把半失的记忆带回言语或意识中
senses.example: The old song elicited a story about his first job.
senses.exampleCN: 那首老歌唤起了一个关于他第一份工作的故事。
senses.why: Memory is stored below speech; a small cue can pull it up whole.
senses.whyCN: 记忆储存在言语之下；一个小小的线索就能把整块提上来。

senses.title: Win applause
senses.definition: to cause an audience to give a visible sign of approval
senses.definitionCN: 使观众给出可见的赞许表示
senses.example: Her final line elicited applause that lasted a minute.
senses.exampleCN: 她最后一句赢得了持续一分钟的掌声。
senses.why: Applause is offered, not commanded, so when it is elicited the performance has done the pulling.
senses.whyCN: 掌声是自愿给出的，不是被命令的，因此被引出时，是表演做了拉动。

senses.title: Gather information
senses.definition: to obtain facts from people or systems by skilled asking
senses.definitionCN: 通过有技巧的询问从人或系统中取得事实
senses.example: The survey elicited useful answers about commuting.
senses.exampleCN: 这份调查获取了关于通勤的有用回答。
senses.why: In research the word is neutral: information is collected by design, not by luck.
senses.whyCN: 在研究语境中这个词是中性的：信息按设计收集，而非靠运气。

senses.title: Draw out a smile
senses.definition: to cause a small, often involuntary expression of pleasure
senses.definitionCN: 使一个细小、常常不由自主的愉快表情出现
senses.example: A single silly drawing elicited a smile from the child.
senses.exampleCN: 一幅傻气的简笔画逗出了孩子的微笑。
senses.why: A smile is the least guarded reaction, which makes it the clearest proof of eliciting.
senses.whyCN: 微笑是最不设防的反应，因此是「引出」最清楚的证据。

senses.title: Provoke a response
senses.definition: to stir a strong response, sometimes against the responder's will
senses.definitionCN: 激起强烈回应，有时违背回应者的意愿
senses.example: The speech elicited anger he had not expected.
senses.exampleCN: 这场演讲激起了他未曾预料的愤怒。
senses.why: Here eliciting shades toward provoking: the response comes out before it can be filtered.
senses.whyCN: 这里的 elicit 已偏向 provoke：回应还没来得及过滤就出来了。

intro.en: Elicit comes from a Latin verb meaning to lure out, and its old cousins include lace and delicacy.
intro.cn: elicit 来自一个意为「诱出」的拉丁动词，它的古老亲属包括 lace 与 delicacy。

items.en: English took the verb in the 17c. from Latin, mostly in scholarly prose.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪从拉丁语借入这个动词，多见于学术文字。

items.en: Elicere meant 'to draw out, to entice forth', as bait draws a fish.
items.cn: elicere 意为「引出、诱出」，像饵把鱼引出来。

items.en: The prefix ex- means out; the motion is always from inside to surface.
items.cn: 前缀 ex- 意为向外；动作总是从内部到表面。

items.en: Lacere 'to entice' is the base, related to the idea of a lure.
items.cn: lacere「引诱」是词基，与「饵」的观念相关。

items.en: Modern English uses it for answers, data and reactions, all drawn out by method.
items.cn: 现代英语用它指回答、数据与反应，都是被方法引出来的。

note.en: The look-alike group sounds nearly identical and is often confused; the near-meaning group names other ways of bringing something forth.
note.cn: 形近组读音几乎相同，常被混淆；近义组列出其它把事物带出来的方式。

entries.definition: forbidden by law or rule.
entries.definitionCN: 被法律或规则禁止的。

entries.definition: the act of drawing something out.
entries.definitionCN: 引出某物的行为。

entries.definition: a person or thing that draws out a response
entries.definitionCN: 诱出者；引出物

entries.definition: omitted or merged in sound.
entries.definitionCN: 被省略或读音合并的。

entries.definition: to bring a memory or feeling into the mind.
entries.definitionCN: 把记忆或情感唤入心中。

entries.definition: to remove something by force or process.
entries.definitionCN: 用力量或工序取出某物。

entries.definition: to stir a strong response, often deliberately.
entries.definitionCN: 激起强烈回应，常为有意。

entries.definition: to bring out something that exists in hidden form.

dict_mnemonic.text: elicitation ＝ elicit（引出）＋ -ation（名词后缀，表行为／过程）＝「引出这件事」。动词 elicit ＝ e-（向外）＋ licit（来自拉丁 lacere「引诱」，注意不是 licere「允许」）＝用诱饵把东西引出来。关键辨析：elicit 与 illicit 读音几乎一样，但 illicit 是形容词「非法的」（il- 不 ＋ licit 合法），拼写差一个字母，考试常考。三个高频术语直接背：requirements elicitation 需求获取（软件工程）、knowledge elicitation 知识获取（专家系统）、elicitation technique 启发式提问（语言教学）。近义 extraction 靠用力拔（extract a tooth 拔牙），evocation 靠唤起记忆情感，prompting 靠给提示。

root: 拉丁语 ex-（向外）＋ lacere（引诱）→ elicere（引出）→ elicit ＋ -ation → elicitation（引出；诱出）

senses.example: The crew eliminated every trace of waste before the inspection.
senses.exampleCN: 检查前工人清掉了所有废弃物的痕迹。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to turn something out of doors, with limen as the threshold, so the core picture is putting an unwanted thing outside the house.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语原义是「赶出门外」，limen 就是门槛，所以核心画面是把不想要的东西放到屋外。

senses.title: To knock a team out of a contest
senses.definition: to defeat a player or team so that they leave a competition
senses.definitionCN: 击败选手或队伍，使其离开比赛
senses.example: Our team was eliminated in the first round.
senses.exampleCN: 我们队在第一轮就被淘汰了。
senses.why: A losing side is pushed out of the tournament the way a thing is pushed out of the door, so the same verb describes sporting removal.
senses.whyCN: 输掉的一方被挤出赛事，就像东西被赶出门外，于是同一个动词也用来描述赛场上的出局。

senses.title: To rule something out
senses.definition: to show that something is not possible or not involved
senses.definitionCN: 证明某事不可能或与某事无关
senses.example: The police eliminated him as a suspect.
senses.exampleCN: 警方排除了他的嫌疑。
senses.why: When a suspect is cleared, that person is removed from the list of possibilities, which is again a mental clearing away.
senses.whyCN: 嫌疑人被洗清后，就从可能性名单里被拿掉了，这仍是一种思维上的清除。

senses.title: To kill, in formal use
senses.definition: to kill a person or animal, used in formal or euphemistic writing
senses.definitionCN: 杀死人或动物，用于正式或委婉的表达
senses.example: The disease eliminated entire herds.
senses.exampleCN: 这种病消灭了整群牲畜。
senses.why: The strongest form of removal is to take a life, so the verb stretches from clearing objects to clearing living things.
senses.whyCN: 最彻底的清除是夺走生命，于是这个动词从清理物品延伸到清除活物。

intro.en: Eliminate comes from Latin eliminare, to turn out of doors, built on limen, a threshold.
intro.cn: eliminate 出自拉丁语 eliminare，意为「赶出门外」，其根是 limen（门槛）。

items.en: Limen meant threshold or doorway, the line between inside and outside.
items.cn: limen 意为门槛、门口，是内与外之间的界线。

items.en: The verb eliminare meant to turn someone out of the house.
items.cn: 动词 eliminare 意为把人赶出屋外。

items.en: Its participle eliminatus carried the sense of having been put out.
items.cn: 其分词 eliminatus 带有「已被赶出去」的意思。

items.en: English borrowed the verb and widened it from people to things and ideas.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪借入该动词，并把对象从人扩大到事物与观念。

items.en: Sports, medicine and logic each took the word for their own kind of removal.
items.cn: 体育、医学与逻辑各自取用这个词，表达本领域的「去除」。

note.en: The look-alike group stays inside the elimination family; the near-meaning group separates ordinary removal, total destruction and exclusion.
note.cn: 形近组留在 elimination 词族内部；近义组区分一般去除、彻底根除与排除在外。

dict_mnemonic.text: elite 来自古法语 eslite「被选中的人」，词根是拉丁 eligere（e- 外 ＋ legere 挑）＝挑出来。所以 elite 的本义就是「被挑出来的那一批」：the elite 精英（集合名词，谓语可用复数），elite athletes 顶尖运动员，elite forces 精锐部队，the ruling elite 统治精英。加后缀派生：-ism → elitism 精英主义（认为该由少数优秀者领导），-ist → elitist 精英主义者（常带贬义）。同根词 elect 选举、select 挑选、eligible 符合条件的。近义 aristocracy 靠出身的贵族，vanguard 走在最前面的先锋，the cream of the crop 一批里最好的部分。注意 elite 作形容词时没有 -er/-est，比较级用 more elite。

dict_mnemonic.text: ellipse 与 ellipsis 同出希腊语 elleipsis「不足、留下」，词根 leipein＝留下。英语在 17 世纪把两者分家：ellipse 专指「椭圆」，ellipsis 专指「省略；省略号（…）」。形容词 elliptical 两头都管：an elliptical orbit 椭圆轨道，an elliptical remark 省略得让人猜的话。同根还有 eclipse（ec- 向外 ＋ leipein 留下＝光被留下外面＝食）与 ecliptic（黄道，因为食只发生在这条线上）。几何记忆法：两颗图钉 ＋ 一圈线 ＋ 一支铅笔＝椭圆，两钉就是两个焦点 foci，线长不变就是「距离之和为常数」。长轴 major axis、短轴 minor axis、离心率 eccentricity。近义 oval 泛指卵形（不要求两焦点），circle 是离心率为零的特殊椭圆。

root: 希腊语 en-（在内）＋ leipein（留下）→ elleipein → elleipsis（不足）→ ellipse（椭圆）

dict_mnemonic.text: eloquence ＝ e-（向外）＋ loqu（说话，拉丁 loqui）＋ -ence（名词后缀，表性质）＝「把话说出来的能力」。形容词 eloquent（-ent），副词 eloquently。loqui 这一家按前缀分：e-（外）→ eloquent 雄辩的、elocution 演说术；loquacious 话多的（-acious 爱…的）；soliloquy 独白（solus 独自 ＋ loqui）；colloquial 口语的（col- 一起 ＋ loqui＝一起说话）；ventriloquist 腹语者（venter 肚子 ＋ loqui＝用肚子说话）；circumlocution 迂回说法（circum 绕圈）。注意 eloquence 不只是「说得流利」，fluency 才是流利；eloquence 强调打动与说服。the eloquence of silence 是常见修辞，指沉默比话更有力量。

root: 拉丁语 ex-（向外）＋ loqui（说话）→ eloqui → eloquentia（善言的能力）→ eloquence（口才）

intro.en: Eloquent is Latin eloquens, the participle of eloqui, which joins ex- meaning out to loqui meaning to speak; it describes someone who speaks out well.
intro.cn: eloquent 就是拉丁语 eloquens，eloqui 的分词，而 eloqui 把 ex-（向外）与 loqui（说话）结合；它形容把话说得好的人。

items.en: Latin loqui means to speak.
items.cn: 拉丁语 loqui 意为说话。

items.en: Adding ex- gives eloqui, to speak out.
items.cn: 加 ex- 构成 eloqui，意为说出来。

items.en: The participle eloquens means speaking out well.
items.cn: 分词 eloquens 意为把话说得好的。

items.en: English took eloquent in the 14C for a persuasive speaker.
items.cn: 英语在 14 世纪借用 eloquent，指有说服力的演讲者。

items.en: Writers applied eloquent to looks, gestures and silence.
items.cn: 作家把 eloquent 用于眼神、手势与沉默。

items.en: Lawyers used eloquent for facts that prove a point without argument.
items.cn: 律师用 eloquent 指无需论证就能说明问题的事实。

note.en: Eloquent and loquacious share loqui, the Latin root for speak; eloquent speaks well and persuades, loquacious simply speaks a great deal.
note.cn: eloquent 与 loquacious 共用 loqui，那是拉丁语「说话」的词根；eloquent 说得好且能说服人，loquacious 只是说得多。

dict_mnemonic.text: eloquent ＝ e-（向外）＋ loqu（说话，拉丁 loqui）＋ -ent（形容词后缀）＝「能把话说出来的」。名词 eloquence，副词 eloquently。三层用法按「谁在说」分：人 an eloquent speaker 雄辩的演讲者；言辞 an eloquent speech 雄辩的演讲；无声之物 eloquent silence 意味深长的沉默、an eloquent look 传情的一瞥、eloquent proof 明白有力的证据。固定结构 eloquent of ＋ 名词＝「明白显示出…」：a face eloquent of despair 一张写满绝望的脸。比较级用 more eloquent，没有 eloquenter。近义 articulate 强调表达清楚有条理，persuasive 强调能说服，expressive 强调表情达意；loquacious 只是话多，未必说得好。
